description: This GitHub repository maintains a curated directory of building-energy optimisation literature, datasets and software. Its own README has separate tables of public datasets and data sources, reported simulation software and papers with public code. This review enumerated 77 rows in the dataset and data-source table and 21 in the tool table; the linked targets are not themselves covered by the directory licence. The entries include building loads, energy certificates, weather records, reference models and control testbeds, spanning multiple countries and publication years. The publisher states coverage of reviewed literature from 2016 through April 2026. The repository is MIT licensed, while a target must be checked at its own page before any use. Simulation use is source discovery: a modeller can find candidate building-load inputs or control testbeds, then check provenance, access and fitness for the intended scenario. It complements data-building-dataset-collection-nkapila6 with a building-energy optimisation focus. A caveat is that names and links in a curated list do not establish completeness, current availability or numerical quality. The 98 table entries have a separate mapping file; unmatched targets still require individual review.
licence: MIT for the curated list repository; every linked data, model, tool and paper has its own terms.
